5692: City of Chisholm campground at the St. Louis County Fairgrounds, across from the Minnesota Discovery Center and the Redhead Mountain Bike Park trailhead (distinct from the city's Iron Trail campground in town).  16 back-in sites, 40 ft wide by 50 ft long, with water and 30/50-amp electric but no sewer; the city lists restrooms, hot showers, a dump station and picnic tables, and guests may also use the showers at the Iron Trail campground.  Pets are allowed.  Open May 15 to October 31. --Claude
5704: City of Mountain Iron campground on the West Two River Reservoir: 45 wooded sites with electric only, flush toilets and showers, a boat landing, a fishing pier and a swimming beach.  There is no dump station on site; the nearest is 5 miles away.  The caretaker is on duty mid-May to mid-September; outside those months City Hall (218-748-7570) answers reservation questions. --Claude
6829: City of Edmond park on Arcadia Lake, not a state park despite the name: 249 acres with full-hookup, regular (electric and community water) and primitive sites, a shower, a courtesy dock and boat ramp, a swim beach, two playgrounds, three pavilions and hiking trails.  The Cottonwood full-hookup loop takes RVs to 50 ft; the Bobcat and Kingsnake primitive loops sit nearer the water.  The rental includes two vehicle passes. --Claude
6834: City of Edmond campground on 141 acres on the north side of Arcadia Lake, 1.5 miles east of I-35 on 15th Street: sites with electric hookups and community water, a shower, a pavilion and a playground.  The rental includes two vehicle passes. --Claude
7359: Private RV park at 4345 State Highway 31 in Corsicana, about an hour south of Dallas and under five miles west of I-45.  Every site is full hookup with 30/50-amp power, and there are pull-through and covered sites, a pool, a playground, a sport court, a dog park and laundry in two places.  The park also rents sites by the month, tiny houses and RV-and-site packages; CampLife sells 7 sites for nightly and weekly stays. --Claude
7564: Private RV park at 1921 4th Street in High Island on the Bolivar Peninsula, half a mile from High Island Beach and 15 minutes east of Crystal Beach.  24 full-hookup sites with 30/50-amp power, 6 of them pull-throughs, plus a tent area with water and electric; free Wi-Fi, a dog park, a bathroom and shower and a coin laundry.  Short and long stays year-round. --Claude
7667: RV park at the Mineola Civic Center, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit on 38 acres that the city neither owns nor funds.  221 full-hookup sites with 30- or 50-amp power on level concrete pads, and Wi-Fi; the grounds have a splash park, a playground, tennis and pickleball courts, picnic areas and a pavilion with restrooms and showers. --Claude
7826: Private RV park on FM 8 about 3 miles west of Stephenville near the city reservoir, formerly R&R RV Park by the Reservoir, with full-hookup 30/50-amp sites, laundry, showers and Wi-Fi.  As read on 2026-10-14 it has no working web presence: randrbytheres.com does not resolve, stephenvillerv.com answers 404, and its CampLife listing has no park behind it; RV Life's newest review is from October 2023. --Claude
7864: 25-acre RV park north of Tyler off I-20 at County Road 35: pull-through (96 ft) and back-in (54 ft) full-hookup sites with 30/50-amp power, all utilities included, plus cabins and park-owned RVs; showers, restrooms and a laundromat.  Dog-friendly.  Bookings are by phone. --Claude
7897: Private RV park and alpaca farm at 3926 FM 455 W in Sanger, just north of Denton: big shaded full-hookup sites, all at least 70 ft long and 35 ft wide, with 20/30/50-amp power, 21 covered sites, a large pool, the Wander Inn community center, laundry and free Wi-Fi.  Guests can hand-feed the alpacas. --Claude
8295: Private LGBTQ+ campground in Millgrove, one of North America's largest and oldest, on over 130 acres: RV pull-through sites with 30-amp service and non-potable water, tent and clothing-optional sites, cabins and seasonal sites, a heated pool, a licensed restaurant and nightclub, a poolside bar and a general store.  Some sites are for sale. --Claude
8303: Municipality of Meaford campground in Memorial Park, on 468 m of Georgian Bay shoreline: 18 waterfront and 125 forest sites, with full service or water and hydro only, a dump station, public washrooms, a snack shack, two pavilions, playgrounds, an 18-hole mini golf course, woodland trails and a beach with a section for dogs. --Claude
8314: City of Greater Sudbury trailer park on Whitewater Lake at 535 Laurier St in Azilda: 24 sites with 15- and 30-amp hydro and water, a supervised beach (June to August), a boat launch, a picnic pavilion, a canteen, a play structure, a beach volleyball court, showers and washrooms and a dump station for campers. --Claude
